office_does: A Metropolitan King County Councilmember makes county law and adopts the county budget.
race_blurb: Incumbent Claudia Balducci, a former Bellevue mayor, is unopposed.

candidates.summary: Incumbent District 6 (East King County) councilmember and former Bellevue Mayor; chairs the King County Affordable Housing Committee.
highlights: Chairs the Affordable Housing Committee, which set countywide affordable-housing targets; cites planning for more than 200,000 new affordable homes [S1][S2]
Proposed the early opening of the Eastside 2 Line light rail and cites the Doors Open arts and culture funding [S1][S2]
Sponsored the charter amendment moving county elections to even-numbered years [S1]
